Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! HOT HONEY GROUND BEEF BOWLS 🍯🌶️ all I have to say is this one’s viral for a reason. Here’s how I made mine! Ingredients: (makes 4 bowls) 1 1/2 lbs sweet potato (680 g) peeled, diced into ~1/4” cubes salt, pepper, cinnamon - to taste 1 lb 93/7 lean ground beef 1 tbsp tomato paste (16 g) 1 tbsp taco seasoning 2 cups 2% low fat cottage cheese (452 g) 4 small avocados (400 g) 4 tbsp hot honey (84 g) Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425F and line a half baking sheet with parchment. 2. Add diced sweet potatoes, lightly spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and a little cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes, flipping and seasoning again halfway. 3. While potatoes are baking, make the taco beef. Heat a frying pan on medium high, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart into small pieces until fully cooked (~5 min). Drain any excess liquid. 4. Add tomato paste, taco seasoning, a splash of water and cook for 1-2 more minutes, stirring everything together. Remove from heat. 5. Build your bowl with sweet potato, taco beef, cottage cheese and fresh avocado. Finish it off with a drizzle of hot honey and enjoy! ✨ For the full printable recipe + nutrition, search 🔍 “hot honey ground beef bowls” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 🫶🏼 #highprotein #easyrecipes #healthyfood #healthylifestyle #healthyrecipes #hothoney #beef #sweetpotato #avocado

High Protein Honey Butter Chicken Alfredo Pasta🍗🍯🧀 One of the most indulgent meal preps i’ve made! The rich, sweet & savoury flavour of the chicken pairs beautifully with the light, fragrant creaminess of the pasta🤤 Macros Per Serving (5 Total) 635 Calories | 60g Protein | 55g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 5) Honey Butter Chicken - 1000g Raw Chicken Breast, small cubes - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 1.5 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Parsley - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Olive Oil - 40g Reduced Fat Butter (for cooking + glaze) - 20g Honey (for all the chicken) - 15g Soy Sauce (for all the chicken) - 2 Tbsp Fresh Parsley, chopped • Cook chicken on medium heat for 3-4 mins each side in a single layer till golden brown and crispy • Lower the heat, then add extra butter, honey and soy sauce. videos.caption: I have convinced myself to think that @Noah Kahan wrote this song for volunteers, shelter workers, fosters, rescue advocates - all of the above. All of us are constantly advocating for these dogs while comforting them, singing to them, loving them even though we’ve just met them. When the world seems to have forgotten them, we howl for them too. We become their voice, telling everyone that they are still here, still worthy, still ready for someone to love them, still waiting for their moon. A2078007 Olive Oyl just seems like a very special girl. She was petrified and shaking nonstop until I picked her up to cuddle her and then she just melted. She seriously could’ve stayed there all day long, and I would have let her if I had the time. She’s (somehow) not on the euthanasia list yet, but I haven’t been able to stop thinking about her so I’m posting her now in hopes to get some eyes on her and gauge some interest. She is so deserving and I see so much potential in her. Just because she’s an anxious pup doesn’t mean she’s broken or less deserving of love or doesn’t deserve the moon. I am proud to howl for her, sing to her and circle her. BARC Animal Shelter 3300 Carr St #dogsoftiktok #fosteringsaveslives #euthanasia #dogmom #rescue

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Here’s a really simple and delicious dinner idea! Let me know if you give it a go 😄 Chris x CREAM CHEESE CHICKEN | Serves 4 INGREDIENTS ➡️CHICKEN: 2x 250g/9oz Chicken Breasts, brought close to room temp 1/2 tsp EACH: Smoked Paprika, Salt 1/4 tsp EACH: Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Dried Oregano, Black Pepper, plus more to serve 1/8 tsp Dried Thyme 1 tbsp EACH: Unsalted Butter, Olive Oil ➡️SAUCE: 2 Shallots, very finely diced 180ml / 3/4 cup Chicken Stock (use low-salt if sensitive to salt) 1x 165g/5.8oz tub of full-fat Cream Cheese, brought close to room temp (I use Philadelphia) 1 tsp Dijon Mustard finely diced Fresh Chives, to serve METHOD 1️⃣Horizontally slice each chicken breast right through the centre to create 4 even-sized breasts. Combine the seasoning mix in a small pot or bowl, then evenly sprinkle over both sides of each breast. 2️⃣Place a large pan over medium-high heat and stir in the butter and oil. Add the chicken and fry for a few minutes on each side, or until lightly charred on the outside and piping hot/white through the centre. Remove and place on a plate to one side then lower the heat to medium. 3️⃣Add the shallots and fry in the leftover fat until soft and golden. Pour in the stock, then stir in the cream cheese until it blends into a sauce. You'll need to give it a good whisk to smooth out all the small lumps. Stir in the dijon, then stir in the resting juices from the chicken. 4️⃣The sauce should be relatively thick already, but if it's not just gently simmer for a couple of minutes. If you over thicken it just stir in a splash more stock or water to thin it out. 5️⃣Add the chicken back in and baste in the sauce, then sprinkle with chives and a pinch of black pepper. Serve up and enjoy!

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Easy High Protein Meal Prep Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍗🧀 Most Viral Recipe of 2025! 🔥 100+ million views combined across all social media platforms, this high protein honey bbq chicken mac & cheese recipe is the tastiest & easiest meal prep recipe to start your health journey in 2026 👨🏻‍🍳🫡 (Macros: Per Serving - Recipe Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Ingredients: 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Each of Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder 1 Tsp Olive Oil 25g Honey 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce) 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 80g Light Cream Cheese 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar Cheese) Instructions: 1. Start by seasoning your diced chicken breast with 1 tsp each of salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder then add 1 tsp of olive oil & mix well. 2. Cook the chicken on medium/high heat for 4 min each side or until cooked through, once the chicken is cooked take it off the heat & add 25g of honey with 85g of bbq sauce. 3. Mix well to combine until the chicken is coated in the sauce. 4. Start cooking 320g of pasta (uncooked weight) in boiling water according to package directions. 5. While the pasta is cooking to a pan on medium heat add 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk, 80g light cream cheese, 1.5 tsp chicken stock powder, 100g light grated cheddar cheese & continue stirring until the sauce is fully combined & smooth/creamy. 6. Add the cooked & drained pasta to the Mac & cheese sauce then mix until the pasta is fully coated. 7. Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. I hope you enjoy this simple and delicious recipe and follow for more! #fyp #BakeWithMe #sweettooth #cinnamonroll #viralvideo

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside. 3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter to the same pan then the onions & cook, stirring often, until translucent. Add the garlic & spices, cook for 1 to 2 mins. Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with bouillon according to package instructions. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Enjoy! #dinner #easyrecipe #homecooking #tiktokrecipe #fyp #shawarma #chickenrecipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Ingredients * 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (I use thin-cut) * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * Asparagus, green beans, or broccoli Sauce * ¼ cup chicken broth * ¼ cup Dijon mustard * 3 tbsp honey * 2 tbsp olive oil * 4 cloves garlic, minced or pressed * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp dried thyme Directions 1. One Pan Cheesy Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Rice 😮‍💨 INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning   1 tbsp minced garlic BWW Parmesan Garlic Sauce  2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup white jasmine rice, rinsed   1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese  2 oz cream cheese 4 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  If you don’t have any bacon leftover from breakfast cook your bacon, drain the grease, and chop it into small pieces. To keep this recipe even easier you could use bacon bits  Cut 1 lb of chicken into small pieces. Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and spread out evenly in pan. Add the chopped onion and season with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.  Once the chicken is almost cooked add the minced garlic and add 2-3 tbsp of Parmesan garlic sauce to the pan and stir. Add the rinsed rice to the center of the skillet and let toast for a couple of minutes. Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir well. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover with a lid.  Let cook covered for about 15-20 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add about a cup of shredded cheese and the cream cheese. Stir well.  Top with more cheese and the crumbled bacon. Cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes.  Top with dried parsley.  Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out! #easyrecipes #chicken #onepanmeal

My first cozy recipe of the season had to be a little spooky🤭🎃👻 Save this recipe for later☺️ Creamy Tomato Soup & Vegan Grilled Cheese Ingredients: • 5 ripe tomatoes • 2 bell peppers • 1 onion • 2 whole heads of garlic • 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar • 3 tbsp olive oil • 1-2 cups (240-480 ml) vegetable broth • 1 small bunch fresh basil • Fresh rosemary • Salt & black pepper Grilled cheese: • Bread of choice • Vegan butter • Vegan cheese How to make the soup: 1. Cut the tomatoes and bell peppers in half, chop the onion, and cut the tops off the garlic heads. 2. Place everything on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, and season with salt and fresh rosemary. 3. Roast at 350°F (180°C) for 40-50 minutes, until soft. 4. Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves out of their skins and transfer everything to a pot. 5. Add fresh basil, black pepper, and 1 cup of vegetable broth, then blend until creamy and smooth. Add more broth as needed to reach your desired consistency. 6. Let the soup simmer gently for a few minutes. How to make the grilled cheese: Cut a spooky face into one slice of bread. Melt vegan butter in a skillet over medium heat, then add the bread and top with vegan cheese. Cook until the bread is golden and the cheese is melted, then assemble with the spooky face on top. 🍂 Serve together for the ultimate cozy combo🥰👍🏻 #vegangrilledcheese #tomatosoup #veganrecipes #halloweenrecipes #fallrecipes

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

LOADED BUFFALO CHICKEN POTATOES 🍟  These were so delicious and easy to make! Perfect for a high protein lunch or dinner option. Save for later☝🏼 •546 kcals  •44g PRO, 65g CHO, 18g FAT For 1 serving: -250g of potato -2 tsp of aromat seasoning  -1 tsp of olive oil or use low cal spray -1 tsp of paprika -1 tsp of garlic granules -Salt/pepper -100g of uncooked chicken breast -15g of light mozzarella/cheddar -1 tbsp of light ranch (mixed with 1 tbsp of water) -Fresh parsley, chopped Buffalo sauce: -2 tbsp of Franks Red Hot Buffalo Sauce -1 tbsp of light ranch -15g of light cream cheese  Method: 1. Wash the potatoes then slice into cubes. Par boil for 5 minutes then drain. Season with aromat seasoning. Spray with oil, toss and air fry or cook in the oven at 200°C for 20-25 minutes. 2. Season the chicken with 1 tsp of paprika, garlic granules, salt and pepper.  3. Air fry at 180°C for 15-20 minutes. 4. Once cooked, add to a bowl and shred apart with two forks. 5. Whisk together the buffalo sauce, ranch and cream cheese. Then add the chicken and shred apart.  6. Add the cooked potatoes to an oven safe dish and top with the buffalo chicken. Sprinkle over the mozzarella/cheddar and place under the grill for 5 minutes or until the cheese has melted. 7. Remove from the grill. Mix together 1 tbsp of ranch with 1 tbsp of water and drizzle over the fries. Sprinkle over fresh parsley. Enjoy! #loadedfries #buffalofries #buffalochicken #cheesy #highproteinrecipes

POV: your dinner is watching you👁️👁️👻😂🤭 Save this recipe for Halloween🎃 Spooky Eyeball Stuffed Shells Ingredients: For the filling: • Vegan ground beef - 12 oz (340 g) • 1 Bell pepper, finely diced • 1 Onion, finely diced • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Tomato paste - 1 tbsp • Tomato sauce - 1/3 cup (80 ml) • Smoked paprika - to taste • Italian seasoning - to taste • Olive oil - 1 tbsp • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the tomato sauce: • Strained tomatoes - 26.5 oz (750 g) • Agave syrup - 1 tsp • Italian seasoning - 1 tsp • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the stuffed shells: • 18 Jumbo pasta shells • 9 Mini vegan mozzarella balls, halved • Black olives - as needed, sliced • Tomato paste - as needed, for the veins • Fresh thyme - optional How to make: 1. Cook the vegan ground beef in olive oil over medium heat, breaking it into very small crumbles with a spatula. 2. Add the bell pepper, onion, and garlic and cook until softened. Season with smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Stir in the tomato paste. 3. To make the sauce, combine the strained tomatoes, agave syrup, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute. 4. Stir 1/3 cup (80 ml) of the tomato sauce into the filling. 5. Cook the jumbo shells according to package directions until al dente. Drain and let cool just enough to handle. 6. Spread a layer of tomato sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Stuff each shell generously with the filling and arrange in the dish. 7. Spoon a little tomato sauce over each shell. 8. Top each shell with half of a mini vegan mozzarella ball and a slice of black olive to create the pupil. Use a small amount of tomato paste to draw thin red veins over the mozzarella, then add a little fresh thyme if desired. 9. Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 15 minutes. Makes about 18 stuffed shells. #halloweenstuffedshells #eyeballstuffedshells #spookypasta #halloweenpasta #stuffedshells

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. We thought we’d try sharing meal prep early for next week so you can plan ahead! Let us know if this timing is better! CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Sticky Chicken & Rice!✨🍚#homemadefood #EasyRecipes #cookingathome #budgetrecipes #DinnerIdeas  Recipe:  Chicken: * 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cubed * 1 tsp each onion powder, garlic powder & salt * ½ tsp each black pepper & paprika * 2 tbsp olive oil * ⅓ cup cornstarch * Olive oil for cooking Sticky Sauce: * ½ cup soy sauce * ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce * 1 tbsp ketchup * 1 tsp ginger paste * ½ tbsp minced garlic * 1½ tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp butter For serving: White rice, green onions & sesame seeds Instructions 1. Season chicken with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, paprika and olive oil. Toss with cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Whisk together all sauce ingredients except the butter until smooth. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken in batches until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 4. Reduce heat and melt butter in the same skillet, scraping up the browned bits. 5. Pour in the sauce and stir until thickened. Add chicken back in and toss until coated in that sticky, glossy sauce. 6. Serve over white rice and top with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

It’s cheesy, garlicky, satisfying, and ready in about 30 minutes! 😍 Full recipe is on my page, right under my profile picture ⬆️

Garlic Parmesean Wraps✨🧄🌯 #homemadefood #EasyRecipes #cookingathome #dinnerideas #homecooking Recipe:  For the Chicken • 3 chicken breasts, butterflied • Olive oil • Paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, thyme, cayenne, red pepper flakes, ginger garlic paste  Fries: • 2 large russet potatoes, cut into fries • Avocado oil, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt & pepper Garlic Parmesan Sauce: • 2 tbsp butter • ½ diced onion • 4 minced garlic cloves • 1 cup heavy cream • Garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne & fresh parsley • ½–1 cup Parmesan cheese Wraps: • Large tortillas • Parmesan & optional mozzarella Instructions: 1. Season chicken with olive oil and all seasonings. Sear in avocado or olive oil until golden and cooked to 165°F. Set aside. 2. Soak fries in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain, dry, season, and bake at 425°F for about 40 minutes, flipping halfway. 3. In the same pan, melt butter. Sauté onion, then garlic for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, seasonings, and parsley. Stir in Parmesan and simmer on low until thick. 4. Add sauce, fries, chicken, and cheese to a tortilla. Fold tightly and toast in an oiled pan until golden on both sides. 5. Serve with extra garlic Parmesan sauce for dipping and a side kale salad. 🤍

Meals that helped me lose 45 lbs ✨ Let’s make these Cheesy Chicken Mexi Bowls! They taste so good, they’re packed with protein, and they’re perfect for busy weeks. Ingredients: • ~2½ lbs chicken breast, diced • 3 lbs mini golden potatoes, halved or quartered  • 2 bell peppers, sliced • 1 large yellow onion, sliced • 1 packet taco seasoning • olive oil • 1 tbsp garlic powder • 2 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 lime • queso + splash of skim milk (optional) Directions: • Preheat oven to 425°F. • Toss potatoes with olive oil and seasonings and roast 30–35 minutes. • Toss peppers and onions in the potato bowl. Roast 20–25 minutes. • Dice chicken into bite size pieces and add taco seasoning. Cook in a skillet until fully cooked. Finish with a squeeze of fresh lime. • Warm the queso and thin with a splash of skim milk. • Divide everything into meal prep containers and drizzle with queso. High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

High Protein Cheesy & Creamy Garlic Chicken Quesadillas🍗🧀🧄 68g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 Don’t forget to check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes just like this👨🏻‍🍳 (Macros: Per Quesadilla - 10 Total) 468 Calories 23gC | 15gF | 68gP Ingredients:  1.8KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tbsp All Purpose Seasoning 1 Tsp Olive Oil 100ml Chicken Broth 8 Diced Garlic Cloves 350ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 1.5 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder (Vegeta) & 1 Tsp Oregano 100g Light Cream Cheese 40g Freshly Grated Parmesan Cheese Chopped Spinach 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Large Tortillas) 50g Light Grated Cheddar Cheese (per quesadilla - Dairyworks Natural Cheddar Cheese) Instructions: 1. Start by seasoning your chicken breast with all purpose seasoning (or your choice of seasonings) add a drizzle of olive oil & mix well. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side with a lid on top or until fully cooked through. Once cooked set aside. 3. Deglaze the pan with chicken broth then add diced garlic, let it cook & add fat free evaporated milk along with smoked paprika, chicken stock powder, oregano, light cream cheese, grated parmesan cheese & stir well until smooth & creamy.  4. Add chopped spinach to the sauce & let it simmer on low heat, while simmering shred the chicken apart using 2 forks then place the shredded chicken back into the pan. 5. Mix the creamy garlic sauce & chicken well to combine. 6. Place down a warm tortilla, add light cheddar cheese to one half of the tortilla along with a portion of the filling, another layer of cheddar & fold the tortilla over.  7. Toast the quesadilla on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas & enjoy! #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

videos.caption: Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner
